sanskrit_shloka: घेरण्ड उवाच । स्थूलं ज्योतिस्तथा सूक्ष्मं ध्यानस्य त्रिविधं विदुः । स्थूलं मूर्तिमयं प्रोक्तं ज्योतिस्तेजोमयं तथा । सूक्ष्मं बिन्दुमयं ब्रह्म कुण्डलीपरदेवता ॥
text: घेरण्ड उवाच । स्थूलं ज्योतिस्तथा सूक्ष्मं ध्यानस्य त्रिविधं विदुः । स्थूलं मूर्तिमयं प्रोक्तं ज्योतिस्तेजोमयं तथा । सूक्ष्मं बिन्दुमयं ब्रह्म कुण्डलीपरदेवता ॥
transliteration: Gheraṇḍa uvāca | Sthūlaṃ jyotistathā sūkṣmaṃ dhyānasya trividhaṃ viduḥ | Sthūlaṃ mūrtimayaṃ proktaṃ jyotistejomayaṃ tathā | Sūkṣmaṃ bindumayaṃ brahma kuṇḍalīparadevatā ||
translation: Gheranda spoke: They know meditation to be of three types: gross, radiant, and subtle. The gross is stated to be with form (mūrti); the radiant is composed of light; the subtle is the Brahman consisting of the Bindu, the supreme deity Kundalini.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Gheranda spoke: They know meditation to be of three types: gross, radiant, and subtle. The gross is stated to be with form (mūrti); the radiant is composed of light; the subtle is the Brahman consisting of the Bindu, the supreme deity Kundalini.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: घेरण्ड बोले: ध्यान के तीन प्रकार बताए गए हैं - स्थूल, ज्योतिर्मय और सूक्ष्म। स्थूल ध्यान मूर्तिमय है, ज्योतिर्मय ध्यान तेजस्वरूप है, और सूक्ष्म ध्यान बिन्दुमय ब्रह्म है, जो स्वयं कुण्डलिनी परा देवता है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation)
commentary_faqs.answer: Tri-vidha Dhyana (The classification of meditation into gross, radiant, and subtle aspects)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Used to cultivate focus and mental stability, aiding in the management of stress-related psychosomatic disorders and improving cognitive regulation.

sanskrit_shloka: अथ स्थूलध्यानम् । स्वकीयहृदये ध्यायेत्सुधासागरमुत्तमम् । तन्मध्ये रत्नद्वीपं तु सुरत्नवालुकामयम् ॥
text: अथ स्थूलध्यानम् । स्वकीयहृदये ध्यायेत्सुधासागरमुत्तमम् । तन्मध्ये रत्नद्वीपं तु सुरत्नवालुकामयम् ॥
transliteration: atha sthūladhyānam. svakīyahṛdaye dhyāyetsudhāsāgaramuttamam. tanmadhye ratnadvīpaṃ tu suratnavālukāmayam.
translation: Now, the meditation on the gross form. One should contemplate an excellent ocean of nectar within one's own heart; in the middle of it, an island of jewels, made of sands of precious gems.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Now, the meditation on the gross form. One should contemplate an excellent ocean of nectar within one's own heart; in the middle of it, an island of jewels, made of sands of precious gems.
translations.text: Now, the meditation on the gross form. One should contemplate an excellent ocean of nectar within one's own heart; in the middle of it, an island of jewels, made of sands of precious gems.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: अब स्थूल ध्यान का वर्णन है। साधक को अपने हृदय में एक उत्तम अमृत के सागर का ध्यान करना चाहिए और उस सागर के मध्य में रत्नों से निर्मित एक द्वीप का ध्यान करना चाहिए, जो उत्तम मणियों की बालू (रेत) से युक्त हो।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Sthula Dhyana
commentary_faqs.answer: Internal visualization of the divine macrocosm within the microcosm of the heart.

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Used in meditative therapy to cultivate 'Chitta Prasada' (mental tranquility) and reduce anxiety by focusing the mind on symbolic, high-frequency internal imagery.

sanskrit_shloka: चतुर्दिक्षु नीपतरुं बहुपुष्पसमन्वितम् । नीपोपवनसङ्कुलैर्वेष्टितं परिखा इव ॥
text: चतुर्दिक्षु नीपतरुं बहुपुष्पसमन्वितम् । नीपोपवनसङ्कुलैर्वेष्टितं परिखा इव ॥
transliteration: caturdikṣu nīpataruṃ bahupuṣpasamanvitam | nīpopavanasankulairveṣṭitaṃ parikhā iva ||
translation: In the four directions, the Nipa tree, adorned with many flowers, stands surrounded by clusters of Nipa groves, appearing like a moat.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: In the four directions, the Nipa tree, adorned with many flowers, stands surrounded by clusters of Nipa groves, appearing like a moat.
translations.text: In the four directions, the Nipa tree, adorned with many flowers, stands surrounded by clusters of Nipa groves, appearing like a moat.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: चारों दिशाओं में बहुत से पुष्पों से युक्त नीपवृक्ष है, जो नीप के उपवनों के समूहों से घिरा हुआ है, मानो वह कोई परिखा (खाई) हो।
translations.text: चारों दिशाओं में बहुत से पुष्पों से युक्त नीपवृक्ष है, जो नीप के उपवनों के समूहों से घिरा हुआ है, मानो वह कोई परिखा (खाई) हो।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Visualization)
commentary_faqs.answer: Manasa-puja or Visualization of the sacred landscape

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The meditative practice of visualizing natural, orderly environments (like groves) is used in cognitive therapy for stress reduction and psychological grounding.

sanskrit_shloka:
मालतीमल्लिकाजातीकेसरैश्चम्पकैस्तथा ।
पारिजातैः स्थलपद्मैर्गन्धामोदितदिङ्मुखैः ॥
text:

पारिजातैः स्थलपद्मैर्गन्धामोदितदिङ्मुखैः ॥
transliteration: mālatī-mallikā-jātī-kesaraiś-campakaistathā | pārijātaiḥ sthalapadmair-gandhāmodita-diṅmukhaiḥ ||
translation: Adorned with Malati, Mallika, Jati, Kesara, and Champaka flowers, as well as Parijata and Sthalapadma flowers, which perfume all the directions with their fragrance.

translations.description: मालती, मल्लिका, जाती, केसर और चम्पक के फूलों से तथा पारिजात और स्थलपद्म के पुष्पों से, जो अपनी सुगन्ध से सभी दिशाओं को सुवासित करते हैं।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation on divine offerings/fragrance)
commentary_faqs.answer: Offering of fragrant, pure botanical beauty to the Divine as an act of concentration (Dharana-Dhyana)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Aromatherapy and sensory regulation to calm the Vata dosha through natural, pleasant fragrances.

sanskrit_shloka: तन्मध्ये संस्मरेद्योगी कल्पवृक्षं मनोहरम् । चतुःशाखाचतुर्वेदं नित्यपुष्पफलान्वितम् ॥
text: तन्मध्ये संस्मरेद्योगी कल्पवृक्षं मनोहरम् । चतुःशाखाचतुर्वेदं नित्यपुष्पफलान्वितम् ॥
transliteration: tanmadhye saṃsmaredyogī kalpavṛkṣaṃ manoharam | catuḥśākhācaturvedaṃ nityapuṣpaphalānvitam ||
translation: In the center of that (heart space), the yogi should meditate upon the enchanting Kalpavriksha (wish-fulfilling tree), which has the four Vedas as its four branches and is eternally adorned with flowers and fruits.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: In the center of that (heart space), the yogi should meditate upon the enchanting Kalpavriksha (wish-fulfilling tree), which has the four Vedas as its four branches and is eternally adorned with flowers and fruits.

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation) on the Heart Chakra
commentary_faqs.answer: Internal visualization of cosmic symbols in the heart center

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The practice of visualization (Dhyana) in the heart center is effective in reducing anxiety, stabilizing the heart rate, and balancing autonomic nervous system dysfunctions.

sanskrit_shloka: भ्रमराः कोकिलास्तत्र गुञ्जन्ति निगदन्ति च । ध्यायेत्तत्र स्थिरो भूत्वा महामाणिक्यमण्डपम् ॥
text: भ्रमराः कोकिलास्तत्र गुञ्जन्ति निगदन्ति च । ध्यायेत्तत्र स्थिरो भूत्वा महामाणिक्यमण्डपम् ॥
transliteration: bhramarāḥ kokilāstatra guñjanti nigadanti ca | dhyāyettatra sthiro bhūtvā mahāmāṇikyamandapam ||
translation: There, the bees hum and the cuckoos sing. Becoming steady, one should meditate there upon a pavilion made of great rubies.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: There, the bees hum and the cuckoos sing. Becoming steady, one should meditate there upon a pavilion made of great rubies.

translations.description: वहाँ भ्रमर गुंजार करते हैं और कोयलें कूकती हैं। स्थिर होकर वहाँ उस महामाणिक्य (रत्नों से जटित) मण्डप का ध्यान करना चाहिए।
translations.text: वहाँ भ्रमर गुंजार करते हैं और कोयलें कूकती हैं। स्थिर होकर वहाँ उस महामाणिक्य (रत्नों से जटित) मण्डप का ध्यान करना चाहिए।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation)
commentary_faqs.answer: Manasa Puja (Internal visualization/worship)

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The practice of internal visualization acts as a technique to reduce anxiety and stress by shifting the focus from external sensory stimuli to a tranquil, self-created meditative environment.

sanskrit_shloka: तन्मध्ये तु स्मरेद्योगी पर्यङ्कं सुमनोहरम् । तत्रेष्टदेवतां ध्यायेद्यद्ध्यानं गुरुभाषितम् ॥

transliteration: tanmadhye tu smaredyogī paryaṅkaṃ sumanoharam | tatreṣṭadevatāṃ dhyāyedyaddhyānaṃ gurubhāṣitam ||
translation: In that center, the practitioner should visualize an exquisite throne. Upon that, he should contemplate his chosen deity according to the meditation prescribed by the Guru.

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Used in clinical settings for stress reduction and managing anxiety by stabilizing the mind through focused imagery (Dharana/Dhyana).

sanskrit_shloka: यस्य देवस्य यद्रूपं यथा भूषणवाहनम् । तद्रूपं ध्यायते नित्यं स्थूलध्यानमिदं विदुः ॥
text: यस्य देवस्य यद्रूपं यथा भूषणवाहनम् । तद्रूपं ध्यायते नित्यं स्थूलध्यानमिदं विदुः ॥
transliteration: yasya devasya yad-rūpaṃ yathā bhūṣaṇa-vāhanam | tad-rūpaṃ dhyāyate nityaṃ sthūla-dhyānam-idaṃ viduḥ ||
translation: Whatever form a deity possesses, along with their specific ornaments and vehicle, one who contemplates that form constantly—the wise know this to be Sthula Dhyana (meditation on the gross/external form).

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Whatever form a deity possesses, along with their specific ornaments and vehicle, one who contemplates that form constantly—the wise know this to be Sthula Dhyana (meditation on the gross/external form).

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: जिस देवता का जो रूप हो, जैसे उनके आभूषण और वाहन हों, नित्य उसी रूप का जो ध्यान करता है, विद्वान इसे 'स्थूल ध्यान' कहते हैं।
translations.text: जिस देवता का जो रूप हो, जैसे उनके आभूषण और वाहन हों, नित्य उसी रूप का जो ध्यान करता है, विद्वान इसे 'स्थूल ध्यान' कहते हैं।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Sthula Dhyana (Gross form meditation / Saguna Upasana)
commentary_faqs.answer: Fixing the mind on the external form of the divine (Murti Dhyana) to establish initial concentration (Ekagrata).

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Useful for managing scattered mind (vikshepa) and reducing anxiety by anchoring the consciousness on a tranquil, symbolic focal point.

sanskrit_shloka: सहस्रारे महापद्मे कर्णिकायां विचिन्तयेत् । विलग्नसहितं पद्मं द्वादशैर्दलसंयुतम् ॥
text: सहस्रारे महापद्मे कर्णिकायां विचिन्तयेत् । विलग्नसहितं पद्मं द्वादशैर्दलसंयुतम् ॥
transliteration: sahasrāre mahāpadme karṇikāyāṃ vicintayet | vilagnasahitaṃ padmaṃ dvādaśairdalasanyutam ||
translation: In the thousand-petaled lotus (Sahasrara), within its pericarp, one should meditate upon the lotus that is attached, characterized by twelve petals.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: In the thousand-petaled lotus (Sahasrara), within its pericarp, one should meditate upon the lotus that is attached, characterized by twelve petals.
translations.text: In the thousand-petaled lotus (Sahasrara), within its pericarp, one should meditate upon the lotus that is attached, characterized by twelve petals.

translations.text: सहस्रार चक्र के महापद्म की कर्णिका (मध्य भाग) में उस बारह दलों से युक्त पद्म का ध्यान करना चाहिए जो उससे संलग्र है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation) in Sahasrara Chakra
commentary_faqs.answer: Meditation on the internal lotus structures within the crown chakra

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Used in meditative therapy to regulate the neuro-endocrine system by focusing on the crown center to reduce psychological stress and cognitive overload.

sanskrit_shloka: शुक्लवर्णं महातेजो द्वादशैर्बीजभाषितम् । हसक्षमलवरयुं हसखफ्रें यथाक्रमम् ॥
text: शुक्लवर्णं महातेजो द्वादशैर्बीजभाषितम् । हसक्षमलवरयुं हसखफ्रें यथाक्रमम् ॥
transliteration: śuklavarṇaṃ mahātejo dvādaśairbījabhāṣitam | hasakṣamalavarayuṃ hasakhaphreṃ yathākramam ||
translation: Radiant with a white hue and possessing great brilliance, it is described as consisting of twelve seed-syllables (bījas). It is adorned with the letters ha, sa, kṣa, ma, la, va, ra, and further defined by ha, sa, kha, phre, arranged in their proper order.

sanskrit_shloka: तन्मध्ये कर्णिकायां तु अकथादिरेखात्रयम् । हळक्षकोणसंयुक्तं प्रणवं तत्र वर्तते ॥

transliteration: tanmadhye karṇikāyāṁ tu akathādirekhātrayam | haḷakṣakoṇasaṃyuktaṃ praṇavaṃ tatra vartate ||
translation: In the center of that (lotus), within the pericarp, there exists the three lines beginning with 'a', 'ka', etc. (the triangle). Joined with the angles of the letters 'ha', 'la', and 'kṣa', the Omkara (Pranava) resides there.

sanskrit_shloka: नादबिन्दुमयं पीठं ध्यायेत्तत्र मनोहरम् । तत्रोपरि हंसयुग्मं पादुका तत्र वर्तते ॥
text: नादबिन्दुमयं पीठं ध्यायेत्तत्र मनोहरम् । तत्रोपरि हंसयुग्मं पादुका तत्र वर्तते ॥
transliteration: nādabindumayaṃ pīṭhaṃ dhyāyettatra manoharam । tatropari haṃsayugmaṃ pādukā tatra vartate ॥
translation: One should meditate upon the delightful seat (pitha) consisting of Nada (primal sound) and Bindu (primal point). Above that, there is a pair of swans (Hamsa-yugmam), and there the wooden sandals (Paduka) are situated.

translations.author: English Translation

sanskrit_shloka: ध्यायेत्तत्र गुरुं देवं द्विभुजं च त्रिलोचनम् । श्वेताम्बरधरं देवं शुक्लगन्धानुलेपनम् ॥

translation: One should meditate there upon the Guru as the Divine, possessing two arms and three eyes, wearing white garments, and anointed with white sandalwood paste.

sanskrit_shloka: शुक्लपुष्पमयं माल्यं रक्तशक्तिसमन्वितम् । एवंविधगुरुध्यानात्स्थूलध्यानं प्रसिध्यति ॥

sanskrit_shloka: अथ ज्योतिर्ध्यानम् । घेरण्ड उवाच । कथितं स्थूलध्यानं तु तेजोध्यानं श‍ृणुष्व मे । यद्ध्यानेन योगसिद्धिरात्मप्रत्यक्षमेव च ॥
text: अथ ज्योतिर्ध्यानम् । घेरण्ड उवाच । कथितं स्थूलध्यानं तु तेजोध्यानं श‍ृणुष्व मे । यद्ध्यानेन योगसिद्धिरात्मप्रत्यक्षमेव च ॥
transliteration: atha jyotirdhyānam. gheraṇḍa uvāca. kathitaṃ sthūladhyānaṃ tu tejodhyānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me. yaddhyānena yogasiddhirātmapratyakṣameva ca.
translation: Now, the meditation on light. Gheranda said: I have described the meditation on the gross form; now listen to me regarding the meditation on light, through the meditation of which one attains the perfection of yoga and the direct perception of the Self.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Now, the meditation on light. Gheranda said: I have described the meditation on the gross form; now listen to me regarding the meditation on light, through the meditation of which one attains the perfection of yoga and the direct perception of the Self.

sanskrit_shloka: मूलाऽऽधारे कुण्डलिनी भुजगाकाररूपिणी । जीवाऽऽत्मा तिष्ठति तत्र प्रदीपकलिकाकृतिः । ध्यायेत्तेजोमयं ब्रह्म तेजोध्यानं परात्परम् ॥
text: मूलाऽऽधारे कुण्डलिनी भुजगाकाररूपिणी । जीवाऽऽत्मा तिष्ठति तत्र प्रदीपकलिकाकृतिः । ध्यायेत्तेजोमयं ब्रह्म तेजोध्यानं परात्परम् ॥
transliteration: mūlādhāre kuṇḍalinī bhujagākārarūpiṇī | jīvātmā tiṣṭhati tatra pradīpakalikākṛtiḥ | dhyāyettejomayaṃ brahma tejodhyānaṃ parātparam ||
translation: At the base of the spine (Muladhara), the Kundalini resides in the form of a coiled serpent. There, the individual soul (Jivatma) remains like the flame of a lamp. One should meditate upon that radiant Brahman, which is the light of meditation and the highest of the high.

sanskrit_shloka: नाभिमूले स्थितं सूर्यमण्डलं वह्निसंयुतम् । ध्यायेत्तेजो महद्व्याप्तं तेजोध्यानं तदेव हि ॥
text: नाभिमूले स्थितं सूर्यमण्डलं वह्निसंयुतम् । ध्यायेत्तेजो महद्व्याप्तं तेजोध्यानं तदेव हि ॥
transliteration: nābhimūle sthitaṃ sūryamaṇḍalaṃ vahnisanyutam | dhyāyettejo mahadvyāptaṃ tejodhyānaṃ tadeva hi ||
translation: One should meditate upon the solar disc, which is situated at the base of the navel and is combined with fire. Being permeated by great brilliance, this indeed is known as Tejo-dhyana (meditation on brilliance).

sanskrit_shloka: भ्रुवोर्मध्ये मनोर्ध्वे च यत्तेजः प्रणवाऽऽत्मकम् । ध्यायेज्ज्वालाऽऽवलीयुक्तं तेजोध्यानं तदेव हि ॥
text: भ्रुवोर्मध्ये मनोर्ध्वे च यत्तेजः प्रणवाऽऽत्मकम् । ध्यायेज्ज्वालाऽऽवलीयुक्तं तेजोध्यानं तदेव हि ॥

translation: Meditate upon that light which is of the nature of Om, situated between the eyebrows and above the mind; indeed, that alone which is accompanied by a row of flames is known as the meditation on light (Tejo Dhyana).

commentary_faqs.answer: Effective for stress reduction, cognitive exhaustion, and improving focus by stabilizing the sympathetic nervous system.

sanskrit_shloka: अथ सूक्ष्मध्यानम् । घेरण्ड उवाच । तेजोध्यानं श्रुतं चण्ड सूक्ष्मध्यानं श‍ृणुष्व मे । बहुभाग्यवशाद्यस्य कुण्डली जाग्रती भवेत् ॥
text: अथ सूक्ष्मध्यानम् । घेरण्ड उवाच । तेजोध्यानं श्रुतं चण्ड सूक्ष्मध्यानं श‍ृणुष्व मे । बहुभाग्यवशाद्यस्य कुण्डली जाग्रती भवेत् ॥
transliteration: atha sūkṣmadhyānam. gheraṇḍa uvāca. tejodhyānaṃ śrutaṃ caṇḍa sūkṣmadhyānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me. bahubhāgyavaśādyasya kuṇḍalī jāgratī bhavet.
translation: Now, the meditation on the subtle (Sūkṣma Dhyāna). Gheraṇḍa said: O Caṇḍa, you have heard of the meditation on light (Tejo Dhyāna); now listen to me regarding the meditation on the subtle. It is for the one whose Kuṇḍalinī awakens due to great merit.

translations.author: English Translation

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: अब सूक्ष्मध्यान का वर्णन है। घेरण्ड ऋषि ने कहा: हे चण्ड! तुमने तेजोध्यान के विषय में सुना; अब मुझसे सूक्ष्मध्यान के बारे में सुनो। यह उन लोगों के लिए है जिनकी कुण्डलिनी परम सौभाग्य से जाग्रत हो जाती है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Sūkṣma Dhyāna (Meditation on the subtle)
commentary_faqs.answer: The necessity of Kuṇḍalinī awakening as a prerequisite for higher meditative states

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The practice emphasizes the stabilization of consciousness, which is therapeutic for anxiety, chronic stress, and psychosomatic disorders caused by a lack of internal awareness.

sanskrit_shloka: आत्मना सह योगेन नेत्ररन्ध्राद्विनिर्गता । विहरेद्राजमार्गे च चञ्चलत्वान्न दृश्यते ॥
text: आत्मना सह योगेन नेत्ररन्ध्राद्विनिर्गता । विहरेद्राजमार्गे च चञ्चलत्वान्न दृश्यते ॥
transliteration: ātmanā saha yogena netrarandhrādvinirgatā | viharedrājamārge ca cañcalatvānna dṛśyate ||
translation: Having emerged through the opening of the eyes through union with the Self, the consciousness wanders along the royal path (of the mind), yet due to its inherent restlessness, it remains unseen.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Having emerged through the opening of the eyes through union with the Self, the consciousness wanders along the royal path (of the mind), yet due to its inherent restlessness, it remains unseen.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: आत्मन के साथ योग के द्वारा नेत्र-रंध्र (दृष्टि के केंद्र) से बाहर निकलकर, वह राजमार्ग (सहस्रार या मध्य मार्ग) पर विचरण करती है, किन्तु अपनी चंचलता के कारण वह दिखाई नहीं देती है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Trataka (Gazing practice at the eye-aperture/focus)
commentary_faqs.answer: The elusive nature of the self-aware consciousness when projected outward through the senses.

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Managing mental scatter (vikalpa) and improving cognitive focus for anxiety-related disturbances.

sanskrit_shloka: शाम्भवीमुद्रया योगी ध्यानयोगेन सिध्यति । सूक्ष्मध्यानमिदं गोप्यं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् ॥
text: शाम्भवीमुद्रया योगी ध्यानयोगेन सिध्यति । सूक्ष्मध्यानमिदं गोप्यं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् ॥
transliteration: śāmbhavīmudrayā yogī dhyānayogena sidhyati | sūkṣmadhyānamidaṃ gopyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham ||
translation: By the Shambhavi Mudra, the Yogi attains success through the yoga of meditation. This subtle meditation is secret and rare even for the gods.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: By the Shambhavi Mudra, the Yogi attains success through the yoga of meditation. This subtle meditation is secret and rare even for the gods.
translations.text: By the Shambhavi Mudra, the Yogi attains success through the yoga of meditation. This subtle meditation is secret and rare even for the gods.

translations.description: शाम्भवी मुद्रा के अभ्यास से योगी ध्यानयोग में सिद्धि प्राप्त करता है। यह सूक्ष्म ध्यान अत्यंत गोपनीय है और देवताओं के लिए भी दुर्लभ है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Shambhavi Mudra
commentary_faqs.answer: The attainment of spiritual perfection through internal subtle meditation

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: Useful for deep stress reduction, neuro-endocrine balance, and psychological regulation

sanskrit_shloka: स्थूलध्यानाच्छतगुणं तेजोध्यानं प्रचक्षते । तेजोध्यानाल्लक्षगुणं सूक्ष्मध्यानं परात्परम् ॥
text: स्थूलध्यानाच्छतगुणं तेजोध्यानं प्रचक्षते । तेजोध्यानाल्लक्षगुणं सूक्ष्मध्यानं परात्परम् ॥
transliteration: sthūladhyānācchataguṇaṃ tejodhyānaṃ pracakṣate | tejodhyānāllakṣaguṇaṃ sūkṣmadhyānaṃ parātparam ||
translation: Meditators declare that meditation on the effulgent (Tejo-dhyana) is a hundred times superior to meditation on the gross (Sthula-dhyana), while meditation on the subtle (Sukshma-dhyana) is a hundred thousand times more superior than that, being greater than the greatest.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.description: Meditators declare that meditation on the effulgent (Tejo-dhyana) is a hundred times superior to meditation on the gross (Sthula-dhyana), while meditation on the subtle (Sukshma-dhyana) is a hundred thousand times more superior than that, being greater than the greatest.

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
translations.description: विद्वानों का कहना है कि स्थूल ध्यान की अपेक्षा तेज ध्यान सौ गुना अधिक श्रेष्ठ है, और तेज ध्यान से भी सूक्ष्म ध्यान लाख गुना अधिक श्रेष्ठ तथा परम से भी परम है।

commentary_faqs.question: Practice: Dhyana (Meditation: Sthula, Tejas, and Sukshma types)
commentary_faqs.answer: Hierarchy of meditative progression from gross form to internal light to the formless subtle consciousness

commentary_faqs.question: Therapeutic & Somatic Significance
commentary_faqs.answer: The progression of meditation is used to reduce sensory overload and cognitive distraction, aiding in the treatment of anxiety and psychosomatic stress by refining the focus of the mind.

sanskrit_shloka: इति ते कथितं चण्ड ध्यानयोगं सुदुर्लभम् । आत्मा साक्षाद्भवेद्यस्मात्तस्माद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते ॥
text: इति ते कथितं चण्ड ध्यानयोगं सुदुर्लभम् । आत्मा साक्षाद्भवेद्यस्मात्तस्माद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते ॥
transliteration: iti te kathitaṃ caṇḍa dhyānayogaṃ sudurlabham | ātmā sākṣādbhavedyasmāttasmāddhyānaṃ viśiṣyate ||
translation: Thus, O Canda, the rare Yoga of Meditation has been described to you; because through it the Self becomes directly manifest, therefore meditation is considered superior.

translations.author: English Translation

translations.author: Hindi Translation (भावार्थ)
